question: Who among the following has won the Balasaraswathi award for the year 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alarmel Valli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alarmel Valli** is a renowned** Indian classical dancer and choreographer**, known for her contributions to the Indian classical dance form of **Bharatanatyam**.
 
• She has received numerous awards and accolades for her work, including the prestigious** Padma Bhushan and Padma Shri **awards from the Government of India.
 
• In 2019, she was awarded the Balasaraswathi award, further cementing her status as one of the leading figures in Indian classical dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Balasaraswathi award is named after T. Balasaraswathi,** a legendary Bharatanatyam dancer, and is given to individuals who have made significant contributions to the field of Indian classical dance.
 
• Alarmel Valli's dance style is noted for its grace, purity, and depth of expression.
 
• She has performed at major venues and festivals in India and around the world.
